editor.data_help: Raw JSON for this record's fields. Switching back re-fills the form from it.
editor.locale_badge_help: This record's language is fixed for its lifetime.

type_editor.key_immutable: The key can't be changed once the type is created.
type_editor.icon_help: The name of a lucide-react icon, e.g. "database". Also used for this type's sidebar entry when "Show in sidebar" is on.
type_editor.is_public_help: Exposes a read-only public API for this type's published records.
type_editor.is_public_url_help: Published records only, filterable only on indexed fields, and never expanded.
type_editor.translatable_help: Records can exist in several languages ({locales}); each translation is its own record with its own slug.
type_editor.show_in_menu_help: Adds {label_plural} to the admin sidebar under Content, next to Records.
type_editor.collection_help: Gives this type its own document and index tables. Chosen once — a type can't be moved between collections later.
type_editor.collection_immutable: A type can't be moved between collections once it is created.
type_editor.allowed_roles_help: Leave empty to allow anyone holding "Manage record types". Selecting one or more roles narrows access to those roles as well.
type_editor.live_notice: {count} live, {trashed} trashed records — changes are checked against them before they apply.
type_editor.field_key_locked: Can't be changed after the field is created.
type_editor.field_indexed_hint: The single most consequential choice on this screen: filterable and sortable, at the cost of a write per save.

key_error.reserved: "{key}" is reserved by the module: it names a column every record already has.
key_error.pattern: Must start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
key_error.duplicate: Another field already uses this key.

type_editor.conflict_title: This type changed while you were editing
type_editor.conflict_help: Someone else saved a change to this type since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version, then reapply your changes.
type_editor.delete_help: Deletes this type and every record stored against it, including the trash. This cannot be undone.
type_editor.delete_confirm_description: This permanently deletes "{label}" and its {count} record(s) (live and trashed). Type {count} to confirm.
type_editor.delete_count_mismatch: That doesn't match. Type the exact number to confirm.

preview.orphaned_conflict: {key}: {count} records still hold a removed value
preview.apply_anyway: Apply anyway — {count} records will be marked invalid

preview.conflicts_title: These fields still hold values from a previous delete
